text: Program Description Training objectives: This program aims to cultivate students to acquire necessary cultural knowledge of structural engineering, highway and railway construction, bridge and tunnel construction, underground construction, etc., and apprehend the preliminary designing, studying, developing, constructing and managing ability of civil engineering programs. Know the newly development of the civil engineering industry, apprehend the methodology of document retrieval and the ability of scientific research, practical work, computer designing and analyzing, fostering the senior engineer of designing, constructing, installing, managing or planning a civil engineering program. Main courses: Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics, Civil Engineering Materials, Introduction to Civil Engineering, Engineering Geology, Descriptive Geometry and Engineering Drawing, Engineering Surveying, Construction Laws and Regulations, Loading and Structural Design Methods, Design Principle of Concrete Structures, Design Principle of Steel Structure, Basic Engineering, Civil Engineering Construction, Building Architecture, High—rise Building Structure Design, Engineering Seismic Design, High—rise Building Construction, Construction Organization and Construction Project Management, and Engineering Technology Analysis and Cost Estimation, etc. Employment Orientation: After graduation, students can work in the departments of civil engineering surveying, design, construction, management, investment, development and other work related to technological or managerial.
